content:
gina: FYI onboarding CI started failing after the latest typegen regen. sample-app auth tests are brittle.
omar: Job id?
gina: CI #9932. Fail: 
```
FAIL tests/auth-defaults.test.ts
  expected retryAttempts 2 but got 0
```
lucas: Any regen diff reported?
publish-bot: publish-checker: regen-diff detected for 'ts-sdk' -> generated/clients/authClient.ts changed. Potential semver impact: minor (behavioral). Missing changelog entry blocking publish.
anya: Root cause looks like example ordering changed in typegen; generator was inferring retry wrapper based on example presence and the reorder removed that example so the generated factory omitted the wrapper.
gina: Ugh. That causes onboarding to break because sample-app relied on inferred defaults.
omar: Short term we should make sample-app explicit about retryPolicy so CI doesn't depend on inference. Long term: make the generator deterministic and stop coupling runtime defaults to example presence.
lucas: I'll open a codegen PR to add stable sorting of examples and a regen hash unit test.
anya: I'll patch sample-app with explicit retryPolicy in examples as a hotfix.
publish-bot: publish-checker: blocking files list updated.
gina: Also, note semver rules: if we change ts-sdk behavior to align with other SDKs, that counts as a minor bump. We need a changelog entry describing the behavior change.
lucas: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/codegen/pull/999 - deterministic example ordering + regen hash test. Triggering regen.
anya: Hotfix PR for sample-app: https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/789 - examples set retryPolicy explicitly.
publish-bot: regen-and-publish job triggered for thread 2812345678.
lucas: Local regen against PR now matches stable hash.
publish-bot: publish-checker: regen-diff resolved on codegen branch. No blocking regendiffs detected.
anya: Will draft a short changelog: "Explicitly align TypeScript SDK retry defaults with other SDKs to restore parity and prevent onboarding flakiness. Sample-apps updated to pass retryPolicy explicitly."
omar: :thumbsup: publish when changelog is added.
gina: After release bump sample-app dependency and re-run onboarding suite.
lucas: Follow-ups: add a lint in codegen to avoid inference-by-example and add a short devex note about semver for behavioral changes.
anya: Thanks all, closing this thread and moving tasks to the devex board. :tada:
